lines.text: Many learners say: He asked me where do I live.
Better: He asked me where I live.
Where I work! She asked me where I work.

data.wrong: He asked me where do I live.
data.right: He asked me where I live.

native.hook: asked me where 后不加 do！
native.tip: 中文不管是不是问句，语序都不变；学了英语问句要加 do 以后，就容易到处都加。英语里 asked me where 后面要用普通语序：where I live。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “He asked me where do I live.”😅 这里不是直接提问，不加 do：“He asked me where I live.”跟着 Ama 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“He asked me where I live.”大声读一遍，再写一句你自己的句子。免费测验在这里：{link}

en.hook: No do after asked me where!
en.tip: Inside a longer sentence, English does not add do after where.
en.caption: Do you say “He asked me where do I live.” 😅 This is not a direct question, so do not add do: “He asked me where I live.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
